# Batch 3 evidence and unresolved identities

Static metadata only; reviewed against the 44-row V2b gameplay fixture.
`gameOrigin` is the first original-trilogy game containing the represented incarnation, not character/media debut or sprite provenance. No origin is inferred for existing Raimon base versions. GO IDs remain reserved for future scope.

## Applied
- Byron/Zeus, Xavier/Genesis and Rococo/Little Gigant: existing V2c assignments and explicit Batch 3 user confirmation of incarnation/origin (ie1/ie2/ie3 respectively).
- Torch/Gazelle: data.js wave 30 introduction explicitly presents their Chaos partnership; scripts/fetch_sprites.py maps them to Nagumo/Suzuno. Only Chaos + Alius is assigned, not every historical team. Cross-check: https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Nagumo_Haruya ; https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Suzuno_Fuusuke ; https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Chaos . Nagumo source explicitly confirms male and IE2 debut; Gazelle gender remains null in this bounded verification.
- Kruger/Dylan: local Japanese-name mapping and original Unicorn roster: https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Unicorn ; https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Mark_Krueger ; https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Dylan_Keith . Original roster appears in IE3; male verified in character records/categories.
- Edgar: https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Edgar_Valtinas confirms Knights of Queen, male and IE3.
- Teres: local alias Teles Torrue; https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Teles_Torrue and https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Module:PlayerData/IE3 confirm original Empire version and male.
- Chae: local Choi Chang Soo alias; https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Choi_Chang-soo and https://inazuma-eleven.fandom.com/wiki/Fire_Dragon confirm original national-team player (not later coach). Gender left null.
- New registry IDs are explicitly requested taxonomy, not new playable content. No automatic umbrella relation for Dark Emperors or Absolute Royal Academy.

Pages were available through indexed excerpts; direct Fandom fetches returned 402. No scraping, narrative copying or runtime source dependency.

## All remaining roster entries reviewed, unchanged
- mark, axel, jude, nathan, shawn, jack, kevin, tod, tim, willy, malcolm: preserve validated Batch 2; no automatic Royal/FFI or origin assignment.
- david/joseph: local sprite script maps David to Genda and Joseph to Sakuma, opposite to the supplied localized identities; role/move data also mixes representations. Do not repair IDs or assign an original/Absolute Royal incarnation implicitly.
- paolo/fidio: Paolo Bianchi versus local Hide Nakata sprite mapping; Fidio is potentially the same localized character, so neither receives new metadata before identity review.
- jonas: name versus Poseidon lookup does not establish a unique incarnation.
- jordan: civilian name does not establish Gemini Storm versus later national incarnation.
- dvalin: Epsilon versus Epsilon Plus unresolved; script has janus rather than the roster dvalin ID; composite boss inclusion is not affiliation proof.
- darren, sam, steve, bobby, maxwell, erik, austin, caleb, hurley, scotty, thor, archer, canon, hector, silvia, aiden: no explicit version-level evidence sufficient for the target batch. In particular Austin maps to Kira Hiroto in the sprite script; hector is Rika Urabe, not Rococo/Hector Helio. No automatic national-team conversion.

The alias fixture protects all current legacy IDs and display names, including these anomalies; it does not declare disputed mappings canonically correct.
